facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on PSV-4110 during cleaning and preparation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4110 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4110 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 2 August 2006 an incident occurred on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
